prompt: Purchasing is buying a new bandsaw for the shop. No outside workers will be on our site and nothing is being outsourced — we just need the machine itself to arrive conforming to our OH&S requirements. Which ISO 45001 procurement sub-clause applies?
response:
The correct sub-clause for this situation is **ISO 45001:2018, Sub-clause 8.1.4.1 (General)**.

Here is the detailed breakdown of why this is the applicable requirement:

### 1. The Specific Sub-clause: 8.1.4.1 (General)
While many users quickly scan past the "General" sub-clauses looking for specific rules, **Sub-clause 8.1.4.1** contains the explicit requirement for purchasing machinery.

The standard states:
> *"The organization shall establish, implement and maintain a process(es) for the procurement of products and services in order to ensure their conformity to the organization’s OH&S management system."*

Since you are purchasing a product (the bandsaw) and you need it to conform to your OH&S requirements (e.g., proper guarding, emergency stops, noise levels), this is the governing clause. It requires you to define controls to ensure that what you buy is safe before you put it into service.

### 2. Why 8.1.4.2 (Contractors) does not apply
Sub-clause **8.1.4.2** addresses situations where there is work being performed *on your site* by external parties (contractors). The standard defines a contractor as an external organization that performs work or provides services.
*   Since you stated "no outside workers will be on our site" and "nothing is being outsourced," the contractor clause is irrelevant to this transaction.
*   The delivery driver dropping off the machine is generally considered a logistical activity, not a contracted work activity covered by 8.1.4.2.

### 3. Why 8.1.4.3 (Outsourcing) does not apply
Sub-clause **8.1.4.3** applies when an organization makes arrangements for work to be performed by an external party that is part of the organization's operations (e.g., sending parts out to be painted, or hiring a cleaning crew). Since you are simply buying a piece of equipment and not outsourcing a process or service, this clause does not apply.

### Summary of Application
Under **Sub-clause 8.1.4.1**, your organization is required to have a procedure to ensure the bandsaw meets your safety standards. Practically, this means your procurement process should include:
*   Specifying OH&S requirements in the purchase order (e.g., "Must meet ANSI B11 series standards" or "Must include specific guarding").
*   Verifying the machine's safety features upon delivery (receipt inspection) before it is released for use in the shop.
